{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
sales = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Display the first few rows and data types to confirm
sales.head(), sales.dtypes"}
